title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Hey everyone! Welcome to Luka's anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Wow, that's a loud cheer. Seems like you all can't wait a second longer!

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Alright then, we'd better call Luka out to the stage!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah! All together! Ready...go!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len's Voice
rows.Line: Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, everyone. Thank you for coming to my anniversary show today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For those of you at home, thank you for all your comments. I can see all of them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To celebrate my anniversary like this with you all makes me so happy. Truly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I want to express my gratitude to everyone who's found purpose in my music and those who support me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Along with the medley, I have prepared about 16 songs. I hope you all enjoy them until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Without further ado, I would like to introduce my friends who will be performing with me today! Thank you for being here♪
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of us will be performing with Luka today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be getting this venue fired up together, so I hope you're prepared for a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone is cheering so much. We better be sure to reply in kind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then let's keep this momentum up and start the show. As for our first song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, MEIKO. Will you sing with me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure thing! I'll be sure to show the fruits of my labor!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I'll be counting on you. Alright... Start the music!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: C'mon everyone! Let's have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to see more of your smiles♪ Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For the next song... Len, KAITO. If you please.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The first song already brought in so much energy, but... We can't let it stop there, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll make sure my feelings come through my singing. All to celebrate Luka's special day!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I'll cherish this chance to sing with both of you. Now, this next song is going to have a rock-like feel...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey! MEIKO, that's unfair! I want to sing with Luka too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh my. Unfortunately for you, I have no intention of giving my spot to you today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we sing together from this part? Come, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you ready, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Let's give everyone our best performance.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And translate the venue's energy into song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you for listening, everyone!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You did amazing in your solo, Luka! Everyone here and at home was super energetic!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It felt like everyone's voices gave me the push I needed. I had so much fun singing as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's only a few more songs left for today. Singing one after another truly does make time fly by.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If only I could sing like this with you forever...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But it's because our time is limited that I want this to be memorable for all of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To make today a special memory for everyone, I'm going to sing with all my heart until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll be counting on all of you, as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, so that we can give it our all in the last spurt...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, we have prepared messages for you!
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka! Your songs resonate in my heart. And I know that they also give courage to a lot of others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It makes me so happy to sing next to you and help your feelings get across to those people. Looking forward to more years with you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. Getting to see you perform a cool solo and having so much fun singing with everyone just made my day♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka! Let's sing lots and lots more!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka! Your songs hold so much passion, and I couldn't help but get fired up singing next to you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... I know that your feelings have definitely come across! I'm going to keep doing my best too. Let's give it our all until the very end!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka! You're always so calm and attentive that I always find myself leaning on you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But just remember, you can lean on me too, okay? So when you do, feel free to launch yourself at me♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka. You've been so amazing in today's show. Your singing and dancing were more amazing than ever, and even though I was right there next to you, I was spellbound.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your performances are just so enchanting. Once again, happy anniversary! There's only a little left to go, so let's keep this energy until the very end!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright everyone, are you all ready? Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone... Thank you so much for celebrating with me today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wanted to express my gratitude for everyone who has continued to support me through my songs in today's show. Did my feelings reach you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you. Your feelings have reached me too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To return the love you give me... And to express my feelings... I'm going to keep singing for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll continue to support me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm certain your feelings came across, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It makes me happy to hear that. Alright...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's sprint to the finish!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's all have a great time until the very end! The next song is—
